purpose: Thin MCP adapter contract over SongChart Project Kernel resources. Repository/GitHub remain authority; MCP is a transport and query layer, not a memory database.

transport.preferred: stateless remote HTTP when exposed outside local development
transport.local: stdio or local HTTP adapter may be used for development
transport.write_scope: read-first in C1B; governed project mutations remain GitHub/Auto Closure operations

resources.songchart://project/state: derived repository state plus live work-lease overlay when available
resources.songchart://graph/overview: latest completed architecture graph snapshot metadata
resources.songchart://technology/watchlist: SWOT/ROI technology decisions from consolidation authority

songchart.graph_refresh.rule: enqueue/execute a governed single-flight rebuild; never rebuild in an HTTP page request

framework_overlap_rule: Do not duplicate Laravel Boost tools for framework docs, routes, schema, config, Artisan, logs or runtime inspection when Boost can own those capabilities. SongChart MCP owns product semantics, project state, graph/impact, technology decisions and promotion/release evidence.
memory_rule: AI memory may retain user preferences only. Stage, PR, SHA, versions, architecture decisions and release evidence must be resolved from repository/GitHub authority.
